text:
Ava (Mktg): Heads up team / quick visual kit request for next-week webinar on inference economics. Need: 3 hero frames (social 1200x628, square 800x800, slide hero 1920x1080), 2 sequence diagrams (routing + fallback), a compact 1-page SDR cheat-sheet, and a short motion spec for a 20s fallback animation. Deadline: Tue EOD first pass.

Jamal (Design): On it. I only have blocks tomorrow morning. Can someone paste the exact copy and benchmark numbers? :coffee:

Priya (Product Marketing): Paste incoming. Keep bullets punchy so design can fit them on slides.

Priya (Product Marketing): • Headline: "Predictable inference economics: budgetable latency"
• stat: "~2.3x cost reduction vs naive serving with batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)"
• CTA: "Configuration guide + live demo"
• SDR cheat-sheet: 3 talking points, one sentence on routing/fallback, demo signup link

Ava (Mktg): Figma link (view only): https://figma.com/redwood/inference-webinar-kit — drop frames into /assets/hero and /assets/diagrams.

Jamal (Design): Qs: (1) Sequence diagram style — linear swimlane for animation or stacked cards? (2) Sparkline: annotated points or inline legend?

Eli (Webinar PM): Swimlane preferred for the 20s animate. Annotated sparkline with 3 callouts (baseline, batched+cache, dedicated) — we want hover copy too.

Jamal (Design): OK I'll mock swimlane + compact sparkline PNGs and motion spec. Will include static + animated storyboard.

Sasha (Legal): Quick legal note: avoid comparative claims without methodology. The phrasing Priya used is okay if we add a footnote: "Internal benchmark on representative test workload; actual results may vary by model and traffic patterns." Use that exact wording in small print.

Priya (Product Marketing): Adding the footnote copy now and a link to the appendix for the benchmark methodology.

Jamal (Design): Copy for sparkline callouts? I need 1 short line per point (max 6 words).

Ava (Mktg): Drafts:
• Baseline: "single-request, no batching — higher unit cost"
• Batched + cache: "workload-aware batching + KV cache — lower cost"
• Dedicated: "reserved capacity — predictable latency & throughput"

Jamal (Design): Nice. Sasha — can you confirm the exact footnote line?

Sasha (Legal): Confirmed. Use verbatim: "Internal benchmark on representative test workload; actual results vary by model and traffic patterns." Once in, legal sign-off. :white_check_mark:

Eli (Webinar PM): Also need one-liner for routing spiel on SDR cheat-sheet: "Requests routed by policy (latency-first, cost-first, region); automatic fallback to compatible variants maintains availability." Keep it single sentence.

Priya (Product Marketing): I'll add that to the cheat-sheet and post the doc in Figma comments.

Jamal (Design): Plan: initial PNG mockups Tue 10:30 AM, animated slide prototype Tue 4:30 PM. Will push to Figma and tag @Ava @Eli @Priya. If anyone wants to review live, I have a 30m slot Tue 11.

DesignBot: Comment added on /assets/diagrams/seq-1: "need exact routing labels for swimlane lanes"

Ava (Mktg): Routing labels: "ingest -> policy router -> model pool -> fallback" Short tags ok.

Jamal (Design): Great. I'll add motion spec: fade + slide for graceful fallback, 20s total, pause 2s on final state.

Ava (Mktg): Owners: Jamal (design), Priya (copy + SDR sheet), Sasha (legal), Eli (webinar timing). We'll review Wed AM if assets are in. Thanks! :rocket:
